legend: Cat Miston started downloading the series "Police Cat". The series consists of n$$$n$$$ episodes, where the i$$$i$$$-th episode is currently being downloaded at a speed of vi$$$v_i$$$ and the browser indicates that the i$$$i$$$-th episode will be downloaded exactly in ti$$$t_i$$$ minutes, which is not entirely true.

The browser calculates the time based on the assumption that the download speed of the i$$$i$$$-th episode will not change. However, when a certain episode is completely downloaded, the download speed of other episodes increases (there are no other reasons for changes in the download speed of any episode). At the same time, the ratios of download speeds of the remaining episodes remain unchanged. In other words, if vti$$$v_i^t$$$ is the download speed of the i$$$i$$$-th episode at time t$$$t$$$, then for any i$$$i$$$ and j$$$j$$$ it holds that for all t$$$t$$$ less than the moment of download completion of the i$$$i$$$-th or j$$$j$$$-th episode the value of vtivtj$$$\frac{v_i^t}{v_j^t}$$$ is the same.

There is no other network load besides downloading the n$$$n$$$ episodes. In other words, the total download speed n∑i=1vti$$$\sum\limits_{i=1}^n v_i^t$$$ is constant (the same at any moment t$$$t$$$).
Determine the actual time at which each episode will be fully downloaded.
input: The first line of input contains an integer n$$$n$$$ — the number of episodes in the series (1≤n≤3⋅105$$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$).

Each of the following n$$$n$$$ lines contains two integers vi$$$v_i$$$ and ti$$$t_i$$$ — the current download speed and the download time assumed by the browser for the i$$$i$$$-th episode (1≤vi,ti≤1018$$$1 \le v_i, t_i \le 10^{18}$$$; n∑i=1vi≤1018$$$\sum\limits_{i=1}^n v_i \le 10^{18}$$$).
output: For each episode output the actual time it will take to download it.

Your answer will be accepted if its absolute or relative error does not exceed 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$. Formally, let your answer be a$$$a$$$ and the jury's answer be b$$$b$$$. Your answer will be accepted if |a−b|max(1,b)≤10−6$$$\frac {|a - b|}{\max(1, b)} \le 10^{-6}$$$.
Points for each subtask are awarded only if all tests for that subtask and the necessary subtasks are successfully passed.

legend.ai: 猫 Miston 开始下载电视剧《Police Cat》。该剧由 n$$$n$$$ 集组成，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 集当前正以 vi$$$v_i$$$ 的速度下载，浏览器显示第 i$$$i$$$ 集将在恰好 ti$$$t_i$$$ 分钟内下载完成，但这并不完全准确。

浏览器基于假设第 i$$$i$$$ 集的下载速度不会改变来计算时间。然而，当某一集完全下载完成后，其他集的下载速度会提高(任何一集下载速度的变化没有其他原因)。同时，剩余各集下载速度的比值保持不变。换句话说，若 vti$$$v_i^t$$$ 表示时刻 t$$$t$$$ 时第 i$$$i$$$ 集的下载速度，那么对于任意 i$$$i$$$ 和 j$$$j$$$，在所有小于第 i$$$i$$$ 集或第 j$$$j$$$ 集下载完成时刻的 t$$$t$$$ 下，vtivtj$$$\frac{v_i^t}{v_j^t}$$$ 的值都相同。
除了下载这 n$$$n$$$ 集之外没有其他网络负载。也就是说，总下载速度 n∑i=1vti$$$\sum\limits_{i=1}^n v_i^t$$$ 是常数(在任意时刻 t$$$t$$$ 都相同)。
确定每一集实际完全下载完成的时间。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$——剧集的总集数(1≤n≤3⋅105$$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$)。
接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 vi$$$v_i$$$ 和 ti$$$t_i$$$——第 i$$$i$$$ 集当前的下载速度和浏览器假定的下载时间(1≤vi,ti≤1018$$$1 \le v_i, t_i \le 10^{18}$$$；n∑i=1vi≤1018$$$\sum\limits_{i=1}^n v_i \le 10^{18}$$$)。

output.ai: 对于每一集，输出其实际完成下载所需的时间。
当答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$ 时，答案将被接受。形式化地，设你的答案为 a$$$a$$$，评测程序的答案为 b$$$b$$$。当 |a−b|max(1,b)≤10−6$$$\frac {|a - b|}{\max(1, b)} \le 10^{-6}$$$ 时，你的答案将被接受。
只有在成功通过该子任务及其所需子任务的所有测试后，才能获得该子任务的分数。
